author: ThrillSeeker
description:
I spent most of last week at Meta Connect, trying out Meta's new VR Glasses. In a lot of ways this device is actually incredible, pushing current hardware manufacturing for VR headsets into a new age.. but incredible form factor comes with some incredible tradeoffs and compromises. 

Here are my first impressions!
